create_callbacks_from_config: create a Callbacks instance from a Hydra DictConfig to instantiate and cache registered callbacks
notify_on_run_start: notify all registered callbacks when a Hydra run starts by calling on_run_start with the config
notify_on_job_end: notify all registered callbacks in reverse order when a job ends with its return value
notify_on_compose_config: notify all registered callbacks when a config is composed with its name and overrides list
get_callbacks_cache_instance: get the singleton CallbacksCache instance to retrieve cached callbacks by config id
